subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` index arbitrary raw JSONL logs, or should raw-log search stay in QMD, session-memory, or converter/plugin workflows?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but admitting arbitrary JSONL changes builtin memory scope and security posture for sensitive raw message logs, which automation should not decide.

options.title: Document external or opt-in path
options.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only for now, document QMD/session-memory/converter-plugin guidance for raw logs, and close this after that product direction is explicit.

options.title: Add builtin JSONL ingestion
options.body: Implement JSONL admission, parsing/chunking, line mapping, watcher, `memory_get`, docs, and focused privacy/security tests as a core memory feature.

options.title: Defer memory roadmap choice
options.body: Leave this open until maintainers settle the longer-term memory backend direction and which memory plugin should own raw log search.

recommendation.title: Document external or opt-in path
recommendation.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only for now, document QMD/session-memory/converter-plugin guidance for raw logs, and close this after that product direction is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the prior keep-open review and has recent history in the memory host, docs, and extra-path surfaces involved in this decision.
